Flow Cytometry.sample_type: PBMCs / peripheral blood mononuclear cells; monocyte subsets (classical CD14+CD16− and inflammatory CD14+CD16+)
Flow Cytometry.readouts: frequencies of CD14+CD16+ inflammatory monocytes and intracellular IL-6, TNF-α, and IL-10 expression

Hemagglutination Inhibition.readouts: antibody titers against influenza vaccine strains; responder vs nonresponder classification by >=4-fold titer increase

Western blot.sample_type: PBMC lysates and purified monocyte lysates
Western blot.readouts: total STAT3, p-STAT3 Y705, p-STAT3 S727, total DUSP1, p-DUSP1 S359, and p-DUSP1 S296 protein levels
